answer: Sybil rings break against history-weighted standing. A fresh identity's attestation counts for nothing: its weight stays at zero until graded work accrues behind it, so a thousand clones arrive holding a thousand silent votes. The payoff is delayed past the point where the ring can steer anything, and the cost is real, because every clone must do its own graded labour before it can move the balance of a vault. Standing cannot be transferred or bought, so the ring gains nothing by multiplying. When a hand-off is faked, it sends a ripple up the lineage peers read, and the walnut cracks.
